title: News Item
ringkas: Struktur berita: newsworthy event dan background
goals: memahami tujuan **news item**: menginformasikan peristiwa **penting dan layak diberitakan** (*newsworthy*)
memakai **simple past** dan **passive voice** dalam berita
membaca dan menulis berita sederhana dengan kalimat yang padat

lesson.text: Berita di koran, situs, televisi, atau media sosial sekolah memakai bahasa yang **singkat, padat, dan faktual**. Pembaca ingin tahu **apa yang terjadi** secepat mungkin. Itulah **news item**, dan unit ini mengajarkan cara membaca serta menulisnya.

lesson.title: 1. Struktur news item
table: [[SMA Harapan won the Cleanest School Award on Monday.]]
[[The students cleaned the school every Friday for a year.]]
[["We are very proud," said the principal.]]

items.ex: The headline is short and clear.
The TV station reported the accident.
The victims were taken to hospital.
According to police, no one was hurt.
Recent news says the road is open.
Breaking news: the bridge is closed.

lesson.title: 4. Simple past dan passive dalam berita
table: [[Three houses were destroyed by a fire.]]
[[Two people were injured.]] / [[The road was closed.]]
[[The bus was travelling to Bogor when it hit a tree.]]

lesson.title: Judul berita memakai bentuk ringkas
lesson.text: Headline sering memakai **simple present** untuk kejadian lampau dan menghilangkan *a, an, the, is, are*: [[Fire Destroys Market]] (artinya *A fire destroyed the market*). Di isi berita, kembali pakai **simple past**.

lesson.title: 5. Kata kerja pelaporan
table: [["The road is closed," said the police.]] / [[The police said (that) the road was closed.]]
[[The newspaper reported that the bridge collapsed.]]
[[The mayor announced that the school would open.]]
[[According to a witness, the car was moving fast.]]

lesson.title: 6. Pasif dengan by dan tanpa by
lesson.text: Dalam berita, pelaku kadang disebut dengan **by**, kadang dihilangkan.
table: [[The bridge was built by a Japanese company.]]

examples.en: [[Three people were rescued by firefighters. The fire was reported at 9 p.m.]]
examples.id: Tiga orang diselamatkan oleh petugas pemadam. Kebakaran dilaporkan pukul 21.00.

lesson.title: Pakai by hanya jika perlu
lesson.text: Pakai **by** jika pelaku membawa informasi baru: [[The song was written by Taylor.]] Hilangkan jika pelaku jelas, tidak diketahui, atau tidak penting.

lesson.title: Teks 1: Fire in a Traditional Market

lines.en: A fire destroyed about 50 stalls at a traditional market in Bandung on Monday night. No one was killed, but three people were slightly injured.
lines.id: Kebakaran menghanguskan sekitar 50 kios di sebuah pasar tradisional di Bandung pada Senin malam. Tidak ada korban jiwa, tetapi tiga orang terluka ringan.

lines.en: The fire started around 9 p.m. and spread quickly because many stalls were made of wood. Firefighters arrived within ten minutes and controlled the fire after two hours.
lines.id: Api mulai sekitar pukul 9 malam dan menyebar cepat karena banyak kios terbuat dari kayu. Petugas pemadam tiba dalam sepuluh menit dan mengendalikan api setelah dua jam.

lines.en: According to the police, the fire was caused by an electric problem. "We are still checking the cause," said a police spokesperson.
lines.id: Menurut polisi, kebakaran disebabkan masalah listrik. "Kami masih memeriksa penyebabnya," kata juru bicara polisi.

lines.en: Tom, read the news item and tell me what happened.
lines.id: Tom, baca berita itu dan ceritakan apa yang terjadi.

lines.en: A fire destroyed about 50 stalls at a market on Monday night.

lines.en: Good. Why did the fire spread so quickly?
lines.id: Bagus. Mengapa api menyebar begitu cepat?

lines.en: Because many stalls were made of wood.
lines.id: Karena banyak kios terbuat dari kayu.

lines.en: Excellent. That is the background event.
lines.id: Bagus sekali. Itu adalah background event.

lesson.title: Menulis berita sendiri
lesson.text: Tulis kalimat pertama yang menjawab **what, who, when, where**. Lanjutkan dengan **why** dan **how**. Terakhir, tambahkan kutipan: [["...," said Ms. Sari.]] Pakai **simple past** dan hindari opini pribadi.

items: News item = menginformasikan peristiwa penting secara **faktual**.
Struktur: **Headline → Newsworthy Event → Background Events → Sources**.
Jawab **5W + 1H**: what, who, when, where, why, how.
Pakai **simple past**, **passive voice**, dan kata pelaporan ([[said]], [[reported]], [[according to]]).
Headline singkat, tanpa artikel dan kata kerja bantu.

read.id:
JAKARTA – Hujan deras pada Selasa malam menyebabkan banjir parah di beberapa bagian kota. Air setinggi satu meter menutupi jalan dan masuk ke ratusan rumah.
Menurut badan penanggulangan bencana, sekitar 3.000 warga dievakuasi ke tempat pengungsian sementara. Tidak ada korban jiwa yang dilaporkan. "Kami telah menyiapkan makanan dan selimut untuk para korban," kata juru bicara badan tersebut. Hujan diperkirakan berlanjut hingga Kamis, dan warga diminta tetap waspada.

qs.q: What caused the flood?
How many residents were evacuated?
Were there any casualties?
What have residents been asked to do?

read.text:
JAKARTA – Heavy rain on Tuesday night caused severe flooding in several parts of the city. Water as high as one meter covered streets and entered hundreds of houses.
According to the disaster agency, about 3,000 residents were evacuated to temporary shelters. No casualties were reported. "We have prepared food and blankets for the victims," said an agency spokesperson. The rain is expected to continue until Thursday, and residents have been asked to remain alert.
read.title: Flood Hits the City

read.id:
SURABAYA – Kebakaran terjadi di Pasar Baru pada Minggu dini hari, menghancurkan lebih dari lima puluh kios. Api mulai sekitar pukul 3 pagi dan dipadamkan lima jam kemudian.
Polisi mengatakan kebakaran itu kemungkinan disebabkan korsleting listrik. Untungnya, tidak ada yang terluka karena pasar sedang kosong saat itu. Para pedagang kehilangan barang dagangan mereka, dan pemerintah daerah berjanji membantu mereka membangun kembali.

qs.q: How many stalls were destroyed?
How long did it take to put out the fire?

options: A cigarette that was thrown on the floor
A gas explosion in the market's kitchen
A lightning strike during a storm
qs.q: What was the probable cause?

read.text:
SURABAYA – A fire broke out at Pasar Baru early on Sunday morning, destroying more than fifty stalls. The fire started around 3 a.m. and was put out five hours later.
Police said the fire was probably caused by an electrical short circuit. Fortunately, no one was hurt because the market was empty at that time. The traders lost their goods, and the local government promised to help them rebuild.
read.title: Fire at a Market

read.id:
BANDUNG – Sebuah jembatan kayu kecil runtuh pada Sabtu sore setelah hujan deras. Sekitar sepuluh orang sedang menyeberangi jembatan ketika jembatan itu patah, dan tiga di antaranya terluka.
Warga desa menyelamatkan para korban dengan cepat. Yang terluka dibawa ke klinik terdekat, dan tidak ada yang berkondisi serius. Menurut kepala desa, jembatan itu sudah tua selama bertahun-tahun, dan jembatan baru akan dibangun bulan depan.

qs.q: What caused the bridge to collapse?
How many people were injured?

qs.exp: Teks: "a new one will be built next month".
options: A new bridge will be built.
The bridge will be repaired by tourists.
qs.q: What will happen next month?
Pasangkan kata berita dengan artinya:
A wooden bridge ___ (collapse) on Saturday.
The injured ___ (take) to a clinic.
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Warga desa menyelamatkan para korban."

read.text:
BANDUNG – A small wooden bridge collapsed on Saturday afternoon after heavy rain. About ten people were crossing the bridge when it broke, and three of them were injured.
Villagers rescued the victims quickly. The injured were taken to a nearby clinic, and none of them was in serious condition. According to the village head, the bridge had been old for many years, and a new one will be built next month.
read.title: Bridge Collapses After Heavy Rain

read.focus: News item: past perfect dan past passive
read.id:
PADANG – Tim penyelamat menyelamatkan sebelas warga pada hari Rabu setelah tanah longsor menimpa sebuah desa di lereng bukit. Longsor itu terjadi saat fajar, setelah hujan deras turun selama tiga hari. Ketika para penyelamat tiba, banyak rumah telah terkubur.
Warga sudah pindah ke tempat yang lebih tinggi, jadi tidak ada yang tewas. Makanan dan selimut diantarkan oleh Palang Merah, dan tempat berlindung sementara dibangun di lapangan sekolah. Pemerintah telah berjanji membantu keluarga yang kehilangan rumah.

qs.q: How many villagers were saved?

qs.exp: Past perfect dua kejadian sebelum lampau: had rained.
options: The landslide had occurred after it rained heavily for three days.
The landslide had occurred after it had rained heavily for three days.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

qs.exp: Teks: "had already moved to higher ground, so nobody was killed".
options: The villagers had already moved to higher ground.
The rescuers arrived very early in the morning.
The rain stopped before the landslide came.
The houses were strong enough to stay up.
qs.q: Why was nobody killed?
Pasangkan istilah berita bencana dengan artinya:

qs.exp: Past perfect passive: had been + V3.
qs.q: By the time the rescuers arrived, many houses ___ (bury).
Food and blankets ___ (deliver) by the Red Cross.

qs.answer: The government has promised to help families.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Pemerintah telah berjanji membantu keluarga."

read.text:
PADANG – Rescue teams saved eleven villagers on Wednesday after a landslide hit a hillside village. The landslide had occurred at dawn, after it had rained heavily for three days. By the time the rescuers arrived, many houses had been buried.
The villagers had already moved to higher ground, so nobody was killed. Food and blankets were delivered by the Red Cross, and temporary shelters were built on the school field. The government has promised to help families who lost their homes.
read.title: Rescue After the Landslide

read.focus: Reported speech: said, told, asked dalam berita
read.id:
Reporter: Apa yang Anda lihat kemarin? Saksi: Saya melihat asap datang dari pasar sekitar pukul enam. Seorang pria berteriak bahwa ada kebakaran. Saya segera menelepon pemadam kebakaran, dan mereka bilang akan segera datang.
Reporter: Apakah ada yang terluka? Saksi: Seorang wanita memberi tahu saya bahwa dua orang telah dibawa ke rumah sakit, tetapi dia bilang tidak ada yang dalam bahaya serius. Polisi meminta semua orang menjauh dari area itu.

qs.q: Where did the smoke come from?

options: The firefighters said that they will come soon.
The firefighters said that they would come soon.
A woman told me that two people had been taken to hospital.
The police asked everyone to move away.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

qs.exp: Witness: "she said that nobody was in serious danger".
qs.q: What did the woman say about the injured?
Pasangkan kata kerja pelaporan dengan fungsinya:
They said that they ___ (will) come soon.

qs.exp: Past perfect passive: had been + V3.
qs.q: A woman told me that two people ___ (take) to hospital.

qs.answer: The police asked everyone to move away.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Polisi meminta semua orang menjauh."

read.text:
Reporter: What did you see yesterday? Witness: I saw smoke coming from the market at about six. A man shouted that there was a fire. I called the fire department immediately, and they said that they would come soon.
Reporter: Did anyone get hurt? Witness: A woman told me that two people had been taken to hospital, but she said that nobody was in serious danger. The police asked everyone to move away from the area.
read.title: Eyewitness Report

read.focus: Preposisi berita: at, on, in, near, after, during, according to, by
read.id:
Reporter: Apa yang terjadi di perempatan? Saksi: Sebuah truk menabrak sepeda motor dekat pasar sekitar pukul enam sore. Menurut polisi, jalanan basah setelah hujan. Pengendara dibawa ke rumah sakit dengan ambulans.
Reporter: Apakah ada yang lain terluka? Saksi: Dua penumpang terluka di dalam bus. Selama kecelakaan, lalu lintas berhenti selama satu jam. Jalan dibuka kembali pukul delapan. Polisi sedang menyelidiki penyebabnya.

qs.q: How was the rider taken to hospital?

options: A truck hit a motorbike in about six in the evening.
A truck hit a motorbike at about six in the evening.
The road was reopened at eight.
Two passengers were injured on the bus.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "The road was wet ___ the rain."
Pasangkan frasa dengan artinya:
The road was reopened ___ eight.
Two passengers were injured ___ the bus.

qs.answer: The police are looking into the cause.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Polisi sedang menyelidiki penyebabnya."

read.text:
Reporter: What happened at the crossroads? Witness: A truck hit a motorbike near the market at about six in the evening. According to the police, the road was wet after the rain. The rider was taken to hospital by ambulance.
Reporter: Was anyone else hurt? Witness: Two passengers were injured on the bus. During the accident, the traffic stopped for an hour. The road was reopened at eight. The police are looking into the cause.
read.title: Reporting the Accident

read.focus: Articles dalam berita: a/an dan the
read.id:
Reporter: Sebuah kecelakaan terjadi di jalan tol pagi ini. Sebuah truk menabrak mobil dekat jembatan. Sopir mobil itu dibawa ke rumah sakit. Polisi tiba dalam satu jam.
Reporter: Seorang saksi mengatakan truk itu melaju terlalu kencang. Polisi sedang menyelidiki penyebabnya. Jalan ditutup selama dua jam, dan lalu lintas padat. Itu pagi yang tidak biasa bagi kota ini.

qs.exp: Reporter: "An accident happened on the highway this morning."
qs.q: Where did the accident happen?

options: A accident happened on the highway.
An accident happened on the highway.
The police arrived within an hour.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

qs.exp: Mobil pertama disebut dan diawali konsonan → a car.
qs.q: Choose the correct article: "A truck hit ___ car near the bridge."
Pasangkan frasa dengan aturannya:

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan a, an, atau the:
qs.q: ___ accident happened on the highway this morning.

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan a, an, atau the:
qs.q: The police are investigating ___ cause.

qs.answer: The police arrived within an hour.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Polisi tiba dalam satu jam."

read.text:
Reporter: An accident happened on the highway this morning. A truck hit a car near the bridge. The driver of the car was taken to a hospital. The police arrived within an hour.
Reporter: A witness said that the truck was driving too fast. The police are investigating the cause. The road was closed for two hours, and the traffic was heavy. It was an unusual morning for the city.
read.title: Breaking News

read.focus: Preposisi gerak dalam berita: into, off, across, towards, out of, past
read.id:
Sebuah bus tergelincir keluar dari jalan dan menabrak pagar dekat jembatan sungai pada hari Senin. Bus itu sedang melintasi jembatan ketika bannya pecah. Bus meluncur menuju tepi dan berhenti tepat sebelum sungai.
Penumpang memanjat keluar dari jendela, dan penyelamat berlari menuju bus. Semua turun dengan selamat. Lalu lintas dihentikan, dan mobil dialihkan mengitari area itu melalui jalan samping. Polisi mengatakan sopir telah melampaui batas kecepatan.

qs.q: What happened to the bus?

options: Passengers climbed out of the windows.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "The bus was driving ___ the bridge. (melintasi)"
Pasangkan frasa dengan artinya:
The bus crashed ___ a fence. (menabrak)

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan out of atau into:
qs.q: Passengers climbed ___ the windows. (keluar)
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Penyelamat berlari menuju bus."

read.text:
A bus skidded off the road and crashed into a fence near the river bridge on Monday. The bus was driving across the bridge when its tire burst. It slid towards the edge and stopped just before the river.
Passengers climbed out of the windows, and rescuers ran towards the bus. Everyone got off safely. Traffic was stopped, and cars were sent around the area through a side road. Police said that the driver had gone past the speed limit.
read.title: Accident on the Bridge

read.id: Hujan lebat melanda kota kemarin. Banyak jalan terendam banjir, dan banyak orang tidak bisa pergi bekerja. Tidak banyak lalu lintas, tetapi beberapa bus berhenti. Beberapa keluarga kehilangan rumah mereka. Petugas berkata mereka tidak punya perahu lagi.

qs.exp: Teks: "A few families lost their homes".
qs.q: What did a few families lose?

options: A few families lost their homes.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Officials did not have ___ more boats."
Many ___ were flooded.
A ___ of people could not go to work.

qs.answer: Heavy rain hit the city yesterday.
qs.exp: Urutan: Heavy rain hit the city yesterday.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Hujan lebat melanda kota kemarin."

read.text: Heavy rain hit the city yesterday. Many roads were flooded, and a lot of people could not go to work. There was not much traffic, but some buses stopped. A few families lost their homes. Officials said they did not have any more boats.
read.title: News: Heavy Rain

read.focus: Conjunction: because, although, however, unless, despite
read.id: Banjir melanda kota pada hari Senin karena hujan turun selama tiga hari. Banyak jalan ditutup, jadi orang tidak bisa pergi bekerja. Meskipun air sudah surut, beberapa daerah masih basah. Petugas mengatakan bahwa relawan membantu sementara tim penyelamat membersihkan jalan.

qs.exp: Teks: "because it rained for three days".
options: The river dried up last week.
Many roads were closed on Monday.
qs.q: Why did the flood hit the city?

options: Many roads were closed, because people could not go to work.
Many roads were closed, so people could not go to work.
A flood hit the city on Monday.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "A flood hit the city ___ it rained for three days."
Many roads were closed, ___ people could not go to work.
___ the water has gone down, some areas are still wet.

qs.answer: Volunteers are helping while the rescue team cleans the streets.
qs.exp: Urutan: Volunteers are helping while the rescue team cleans the streets.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Relawan membantu sementara tim penyelamat membersihkan jalan."

read.text: A flood hit the city on Monday because it rained for three days. Many roads were closed, so people could not go to work. Although the water has gone down, some areas are still wet. Officials said that volunteers are helping while the rescue team cleans the streets.
read.title: News: Flood in the City

read.focus: Modal verbs: must, should, could, might, may, can't
read.id: Petugas mengatakan bahwa warga sebaiknya tetap di dalam rumah karena badai mungkin menghantam pantai. Perahu tidak boleh meninggalkan pelabuhan. Sekolah mungkin ditutup hari Senin. Warga yang tinggal dekat sungai sebaiknya pindah ke tempat yang lebih tinggi. Badai bisa menjadi lebih kuat malam ini.

qs.exp: Teks: "Boats must not leave the harbor".
qs.q: What must boats not do?
Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Boats ___ not leave the harbor. (dilarang)"
People ___ stay indoors. (sebaiknya)
A storm ___ hit the coast. (mungkin)

qs.answer: The storm could become stronger by tonight.
qs.exp: Urutan: The storm could become stronger by tonight.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Badai bisa menjadi lebih kuat malam ini."

read.text: Officials said that people should stay indoors because a storm may hit the coast. Boats must not leave the harbor. Schools might close on Monday. Residents who live near the river ought to move to higher ground. The storm could become stronger by tonight.
read.title: News: Storm Warning

read.focus: Relative clauses: who, which, that, whose, where
read.id: Tim penyelamat menyelamatkan sebuah keluarga yang rumahnya terendam banjir. Perahu yang membawa mereka kecil. Para pria yang mengemudikannya adalah relawan. Desa tempat banjir bermula masih terendam air. Petugas, yang datang terlambat, meminta maaf.

qs.exp: Teks: "The men who steered it were volunteers".
qs.q: Who steered the boat?

options: The boat who carried them was small.
The boat that carried them was small.
Rescuers saved a family whose house was flooded.
The men who steered it were volunteers.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Rescuers saved a family ___ house was flooded."
The village ___ the flood began is under water.
The men ___ steered it were volunteers.

qs.answer: The boat that carried them was small.
qs.exp: Urutan: The boat that carried them was small.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Perahu yang membawa mereka kecil."

read.text: Rescuers saved a family whose house was flooded. The boat that carried them was small. The men who steered it were volunteers. The village where the flood began is still under water. Officials, who arrived late, apologized.
read.title: News: Rescue
